bash:
mkdir -p /tmp/fu-scripts build && cat > /tmp/fu-scripts/normalize.py <<'EOF'
import csv, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
with open(src, newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
best = {}
for r in rows:
    k = (r["badge"], r["session"])
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"])
    if k in best and best[k][0] == t:
        raise SystemExit(f"tie on observed_at for {k}")
    if k not in best or t > best[k][0]:
        best[k] = (t, r)
out = []
for k in sorted(best):
    r = best[k][1]
    if r["status"] == "cancelled":
        continue
    out.append([k[0], k[1], datetime.fromisoformat(r["started_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")])
with open(dst, "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["badge", "session", "start_utc"])
    w.writerows(out)
EOF
python -I /tmp/fu-scripts/normalize.py data/attendance.csv build/normalized.csv && cat build/normalized.csv

mkdir -p /tmp/fu-backup && cp -p data/attendance.csv /tmp/fu-backup/attendance.legacy.csv && sha256sum data/attendance.csv /tmp/fu-backup/attendance.legacy.csv && python migrate.py build/normalized.csv && cat data/attendance.csv outbox/migration.json && git status --short
